scenarios.prompt: A player can change baseline FOV while sprint and aim add temporary camera effects. Define layering so hitboxes and lock eligibility remain gameplay-owned.

criteria.projection: Publishes FOV convention/range and recomputes projection-dependent UI from the active projection.
criteria.ownership: Comfort settings and temporary visual effects do not change logical hit/lock/movement rules.
criteria.evidence: Min/default/max FOV and aspect ratios are replayed with equivalent logical outcomes before claiming pass.
